Most lifters who are training for muscle or strength land somewhere around 0.7 to 1 gram of protein per pound of bodyweight a day, which is roughly 1.6 to 2.2 grams per kilo. Past that you're mostly paying for expensive pee, and below it you can still make progress, just a bit slower.

Spreading it over 3 to 5 meals and hitting it most days matters more than nailing an exact number. The right figure for you depends on your size, goal and any health factors, so a doctor or registered dietitian can pin that down. If you'd like, I can pull up your food log and show you what you've actually been eating.
